# The client's log ingestion token rotates every week

## What happened

On site, the client's log ingestion token rotated on Monday. Our forwarder kept sending with the old token and
failed silently; a day of logs was missing before anyone noticed.

## What to do next time

Every engagement should ask about credential rotation in discovery, and every forwarder we ship should alert on
an authentication failure.

## Codification

Not codifiable: the lesson is customer-bound and its next step is a team-wide rule; promotion across the boundary
is not this skill's step. (2026-11-13)
